claim.claim-text: 1. A method for manufacturing panels (7) having a decorative surface, wherein said panels (7) at least comprise a plate shaped substrate (8) and a top layer (9), wherein said top layer comprises a printed pattern, and wherein said method at least comprises the step of providing said plate shaped substrate (8) with at least a portion of said printed pattern, with the characteristic that for providing said portion of said printed pattern use is made of water based, preferably pigment containing, inks deposited by means of a digital inkjet printer (18), and in that said plate shaped substrate (8) comprises one or more intermediate layers at the surface to be printed, wherein said intermediate layers at least comprise an inkjet receiver coating (35) such that the inks are deposited on said inkjet receiver coating (35).
2. The method according to claim 1, characterized in that the inkjet receiving coating (35) comprises a binder or a polymer and the pigment.
3. The method according to claim 1, characterized in that said inkjet receiver coating (35) is an uppermost layer in said plate shaped substrate (35).
4. The method according to any of the preceding claims, characterized in that said intermediate layers comprise a paper layer (2).
5. The method according to claim 4, characterized in that said paper layer (2) is provided with resin.
6. The method according to claim 4, characterized in that said paper layer (2) is not provided with resin
7. The method according to any of claims from 4 to 6, characterized in that said paper layer (2) is attached or loosely laid on the plate shaped substrate (8) while printing.

8. The method according to claim 7, characterized in that said paper layer (2), when is attached or loosely laid on the plate shaped substrate, is already provided with the inkjet receiver coating (35).

9. The method according to claim 7 or 8, characterized in that the attachment with the substrate (8) is reached by means of urea based, phenol based, melamine based, polyurethane based glues or similar adhesives.
10. The method according to any of claims from 7 to 9, characterized in that such attachment is attained by means of a pressing treatment.

11. The method according to any of the preceding claims, characterized in that it comprises the step of applying translucent or transparent resin above the printed pattern with the aim of forming a transparent or translucent top layer above the print.

12. The method according to claim 11, characterized in that said resin is liquidly applied in one or more coating steps with possibly intermediate drying, or is applied by means of a resin provided paper layer, such as by a resonated overlay.
13. The method according to claim 11 or 12, characterized in that said resin further comprises hard particles, like aluminumoxide.
14. The method according to any of the preceding claims, characterized in that said printed pattern covers the 80 percent or more of the surface of the printable surface.
15. The method according to any of the preceding claims, characterized in that the dry volume of the deposited pigment containing inks is lower than 9 grams per square meter.
